parsed.note_claim: Publishing personal information such as names and phone numbers of proposers on SNS may constitute privacy infringement under Civil Code Article 709.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 不法行為（民法 709 条）に基づく慰謝料請求
parsed.reason: The page confirms that unauthorized disclosure of personal information is privacy infringement and damages can be claimed under Civil Code Article 709.
